title: Charlie D NDE 4510
content: After the motor vehicle accident, I was brought to the hospital via ambulance and have no recall of that. Once I was in the intensive care unit, I went into cardiac arrest. I seemed to drift away and then suddenly, I accelerated not with my body but with my spirit or essence. I went up through the ceiling, into a path/tunnel that led to an all-knowing, all-loving, comforting, and peaceful light. This light was a familiar, yet embracing light. The tunnel/path had silhouettes of beings on the other side of some undefined boundary I could hear sounds but not intelligible. This place was free of pain and I felt I was one with all. I had arrived to a place without pain. My vision was 360 degrees it was profoundly beautiful. I remember stopping I don't remember how or why. I did have a past life review. Then I found my spirit floating at the ceiling of the intensive care unit looking for something. I saw a patient with a very high fever another with all kinds of head bandages. Then I saw all this activity around a bed and came over it. It was ME. At that very second, I burst into my body I was back to the awful pain. I realized I had been given a choice, life or death.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident It was an auto accident. My car was hit by a drunk driver. I was the only survivor. The person who was drunk died a few days later (which I knew but didn't know how) My girl friend was also killed. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) MVA I sustained 13 broken bones 300 stiches and went through 20 unites of blood. I was driving my girlfriend to Kennedy Airport in New York when we were struck head on without any warning. Marilyn was killed on impact. The drunk driver died a few days later. I was thrown thirty feet from the car in which we were driving. I wanted to get up and get back to the car which was physically impossible due to the injuries I sustained.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Boundary
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Consciousness and alertness came quickly into focus.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Consciousness and alertness came quickly into focus.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time did not exist never saw a window or a door I don't know why that comes to mind.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I was vision I had 360 degree vision it was a wonderland.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: When I first left my body The sound was distant or muffled. When I returned it became clearer.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Through the ceiling and it felt like I was a rocket blasting toward the beautiful loving light, a channel to the light.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light was very bright yet you could look at it and it was part of you.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was traveling through it seemed like outer space to the light.It was beyound words and full comprehension
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Absolute love, warmth of the light and yet being part of the light all at once. Joy at being, knowing you have all of life's truth within.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control It helped me to live my life better to understand physical and spiritual beauty.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I feel more intuitive with people, animals and everyday life choices.
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes I felt I was in a tunnel /path and other things where outside this boundary.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes Traditional religion is gone for me. I believe we are the sum total of God collectively and singularly, from every molecule to every grain of sand.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Traditional religion is gone for me. I believe we are the sum total of God collectively and singularly, from every molecule to every grain of sand.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes That the sum total of our existence, our purpose is unconditional and pure LOVE to every aspect of life.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I have become at better person, who understands pain, love and joy. That honesty and integrity are all part of loving yourself and your fellow man.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I have become at better person, who understands pain, love and joy. That honesty and integrity are all part of loving yourself and your fellow man. After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I feel some times I have ESP. There is something else that other people who are good friends say I project such positive energy that they need a 'Charlie fix'.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: After all the pain and suffering I would suffer it all again for that moment in time. It profoundly changed my being.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes The very first time was to a doctor friend that I met while recovering from this accident I was in the Hospital for seventy days. The doctor was from India and he would come and visit after his shift. I told him about the OBE and I explained to him how wonderful it was.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I live today a much better person who knows who he is and fiber of my being.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I'm sixty-two years old with endless energy, due to knowing the true purpose of life. It is a never-ending reality which I'll carry ever forward. This experience has never let me down knowing about all the love we have to share.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No I've come across a book that might be of interest 'DMT the Spirit Molecule' by Rick Strassman M.D.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: As a result and benefit of this experience I have no fear of death and in a hospital environment I'm able to use this experience for patient benefit.
